policy.iteration_semantics: Only explicitly allowlisted jobs may run in draft iteration mode. Every unlisted or newly added CI job is full-only until reviewed.

rationale.governance: Source-level Class A/B ownership gate; cheap and directly relevant to every PR review boundary.
rationale.cls-field-count: Fast architectural ratchet protecting CognitiveLoopService decomposition.
rationale.workspace-targets: Workspace/build-target and crate-registry integrity checks; prevents structurally invalid candidates from consuming larger qualification lanes.
rationale.embodiment-safety-composition: Fast source-level safety-composition check; safety regressions should be visible during draft iteration.
rationale.orphan-modules: Fast source-tree reachability ratchet covering source/tests/examples.
rationale.secrets-scan: Repository secret-leak detection remains an always-on PR safety invariant despite not being a scientific qualification gate.
